The components list drops OutlineVolumeComponent (-7750755424749557576, GUID 60f3b30c03e6ba64d9a27dc9dba8f28d) and OasisFogVolumeComponent (-5139089513906902183, GUID 5a00a63fdd6bd2a45ab1f2d869305ffd). Neither script GUID resolves in source Assets or pinned package meta files; VolumeProfile.OnEnable removes null components. Their disabled/zero-density serialized object blocks are retained unchanged. No other volume values change.

Exactly 15 m_Prefilter* fields are regenerated shader variant filtering data. The pinned URP UniversalRenderPipelineAssetPrefiltering.cs is UNITY_EDITOR-only, and UpdateShaderKeywordPrefiltering assigns each changed field from ShaderPrefilteringData. ShaderBuildPreprocessor derives that data from the target/renderer/features and explicitly saves the asset before building. Authored renderer references, lighting, shadows, quality and other runtime asset values are byte-identical; this is the package build prefilter update, with no independent gameplay/configuration edit.

The sole change populates m_Settings.m_RuntimeSettings.m_List with 16 existing managed-reference RIDs. Each was already in the original editor m_SettingsList and references.RefIds; all type/resource payloads, version and author settings are byte-identical. Core RenderPipelineGraphicsSettingsContainer.OnBeforeSerialize clears this list and calls RenderPipelineGraphicsSettingsStripper.PerformStripping only while BuildPipeline.isBuildingPlayer; that method selects existing settings objects for the player. The list is expected build-derived serialization, with no new or modified resource definitions.
